style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production horizontal game catalogue cover, landscape 16:9, as part of a unified premium Spanish educational videogame collection for ages 12–16. Hand-painted polished fantasy adventure illustration, crisp confident silhouettes, rich atmospheric depth, sophisticated vibrant accent lighting, dark navy shadow palette, finely textured materials, exciting inviting mood. Same collection style: central foreground game-defining subject, cinematic background, one clear focal point, restrained visual detail readable in a tiny thumbnail. No border, no logo, no watermark, no interface, no text or letters anywhere: the game title is rendered separately in HTML. Composition keeps essential subject inside the central 70 percent of width and height so card crops work.

scenes.battlegrafia: Mage and knight confronting emerald ink dragon above a stone bridge; cyan and emerald adventure.
scenes.maniacgrafia: Maniacgrafía: energetic arcade labyrinth made of glowing cyan and magenta ink streams, young adventurer dashing between floating blank glyph-shaped crystals and friendly ink monsters. Electric purple and pink, speed and precision.
scenes.narratoria: Narratoria: massive open storybook with a living miniature fantasy world emerging from pages, a writer's quill in foreground, winding river, castle, airship and distant forests. Warm amber light.
scenes.versopolis: Versópolis: magnificent fantastical city with violet rooftops, musical wave-like ribbons of poetic ink, illuminated bridges, elegant quill and a floating parchment ribbon in foreground. Violet and gold twilight.
scenes.scrabble: Scrabble: tactile carved wooden blank letter tiles arranged in intersecting rows on a magnificent green strategy board, several tiles floating mid-move with emerald magical trails. No readable letters. Emerald green and warm wood.
scenes.conjuga_apuesta: Conjuga y apuesta: spectacular magical dice and stacks of copper and ruby chips on a fantasy strategy table, branching glowing rings symbolizing possible verb choices. Ruby and amber highlights. No numbers or symbols on dice.
scenes.verb_battle: Batalla verbal: three male fantasy heroes, knight, mage and agile archer, facing opposing magical silhouettes across a tactical arena with glowing blue rune platforms and spell cards. Heroic team combat, blue and red accents, no gore.
scenes.rayuela: Rayuela: storybook path branching into three impossible worlds, floating stepping stones, a magical compass and book in foreground, forest gate, futuristic city and mountain castle in background. Turquoise accent light, sense of choices and adventure.
scenes.entre_lineas: Entre Líneas: cinematic mystery investigator's desk with magnifying glass above a glowing document, evidence threads leading toward a mysterious rainy city and shadowed library shelves. Golden brass, ink blue, intelligent suspense, no readable text.
scenes.tower_defense: Guardianes de la Biblioteca: enchanted monumental library fortress protected by four whimsical defensive towers, magic book projectiles and friendly stylized ink creatures approaching along a winding path. Teal and gold strategic fantasy, no gore.
scenes.word_play: Word Play: dramatic floating blank letter tiles and magical upgrade cards forming an explosive golden chain reaction over a small dark game board, treasure chest and jewel rewards. Cyan and orange light, roguelike arcade excitement.
scenes.tierras_de_tinta: Tierras de Tinta: cloaked adventurer holding a glowing quill blade overlooking vast fantasy landscape, black ink chasm, golden portal, castle, mountains and strange ink creatures. Amber and deep indigo, epic exploration.
scenes.lexaria: Lexaria: three charming collectible fantasy creatures, small azure crystal dragon, scholarly owl creature and leafy woodland creature, on a tactical academy platform, majestic blue and gold magical academy behind them. Rich cobalt and gold. Creature collecting autobattler.
scenes.lexitrama: Lexitrama: expedition atlas open in foreground with carved wooden blank letter tiles and compass, branching map trails leading into a lush forest, desert ruins and icy mountains. Jade and parchment gold, exploration puzzle. No creatures or academy.
scenes.lexoma: FORJA: powerful fantasy blacksmith hammer striking a glowing blank letter-shaped metal tile on an anvil, molten sparks, forge furnace, magical upgrade cards and coin pouch. Orange fire and cool steel cyan, crafting words.
scenes.sopa_de_tinta: Sopa de Tinta: cozy magical nocturnal cafe with steaming teal coffee cup in foreground, blank wooden tile puzzle on a table, enchanted books, ink fireflies, warm window lights and shelves. Mint teal and warm amber, cozy adventure.
